global_summary_cn:
流动性状态：当前市场流动性趋紧，表现为VIX恐慌指数急剧上升至20.95，以及10年期美债收益率保持高位并继续上行，表明强烈的“避险”(Risk Off)情绪主导市场，压倒了美联储略微鸽派的长期利率预期。在消息面上，主流币遭遇“死亡交叉”和技术指标“强力卖出”的集体看空信号，形成了完美的看跌风暴，导致大规模去杠杆化。

比特币（BTC）跌破9万美元关键支撑，带动所有主流币RSI跌至极度超卖区间（低于22）。尽管结构性利好消息（如Saylor再次购入、ETP资金流入）不断出现，但这些买盘被宏观驱动的抛售压力所消化。市场目前处于恐慌抛售后的技术反弹窗口，特别是ETH，由于其负资金费率和极度超卖，短期反弹潜力较大。然而，在PCE数据公布前，宏观不确定性将限制任何持续的上行。
global_summary_en:
Liquidity Status: Global liquidity is tightening, defined by the VIX fear index spiking above 20.95 and the US 10-Year yield remaining high and rising. This signals strong “Risk Off” sentiment, overriding mildly dovish Fed expectations. The narrative layer saw a confluence of bearish technical signals (BTC "Death Cross," "Strong Sell" indicators) resulting in a Perfect Bearish Storm and massive deleveraging.

Bitcoin (BTC) broke the key $90,000 support, pushing the RSI for all major coins deep into panic/oversold territory (below 22). While structural bullish news (Saylor purchasing, ETP inflows) exists, it is currently being distributed into macro fear. The market is positioned for a technical bounce following panic selling, especially for ETH, given its negative funding rate and extreme oversold readings. However, macro uncertainty (upcoming PCE data, US debt concerns) limits potential upside until global fear subsides.
